claims.text: The Yeatman occupies a hillside position on the south bank of the River Douro.

findings.quote: Occupying a commanding hillside position on the south bank of the River Douro

claims.text: The hotel is set amidst the Port wine lodges, on a hill overlooking Porto, within 7 acres of land.

findings.quote: Set amidst the Port wine lodges, The Yeatman nestles on a hill, overlooking Porto and is set within 7 acres of land

claims.text: Every room at The Yeatman has views over the historic centre of Porto.

findings.quote: every room at The Yeatman Hotel enjoys breathtaking views over the historic centre of Porto

claims.text: All rooms and suites have a terrace or balcony with views over Porto.

findings.quote: All of our spacious rooms and suites have a terrace or balcony with views over Porto.

claims.text: The Panoramic Deluxe Suites have a wider, panoramic view of the Douro River and the historic city of Porto.

findings.quote: Our Panoramic Deluxe Suites have a wider and panoramic view of the Douro River and the historic city of Porto.

claims.text: The Yeatman is a member of the Relais & Chateaux collection of hotels.

findings.quote: Member of the prestigious Relais & Châteaux collection of hotels

claims.text: Inspired by Porto's British wine-shipper heritage, the hotel blends Portuguese hospitality traditions with a British flair for understated, stylish comfort.

findings.quote: has been the home of British wine shippers and their families for over three centuries
Inspired by this heritage, The Yeatman Hotel blends the finest Portuguese traditions of hospitality with a uniquely British flair for understated and stylish comfort.

claims.text: The cellars of The Yeatman house one of the most comprehensive collections of Portuguese wines.

findings.quote: The cellars of The Yeatman house one of the most comprehensive collections of Portuguese wines.

claims.text: Partner wine producers take part in the hotel's programme of tastings, seminars and wine dinners.

findings.quote: The hotel has established partnerships with many of Portugal's finest producers who actively participate in The Yeatman's programme of tastings, seminars and wine dinners.

claims.text: The hotel's wine experts are on hand to guide guests in discovering Portugal's wine regions.

findings.quote: experts who are on hand to guide guests in their discovery of Portugal's diverse and individual wine regions

claims.text: Visits can be arranged to vineyards and estates in the Douro Valley, Minho, Dao and Bairrada wine regions.

findings.quote: visits can be arranged to leading vineyards and estates in the Douro Valley, Minho, Dão and Bairrada wine regions

claims.text: The Yeatman Gastronomic Restaurant holds two Michelin Stars, awarded in November 2016.

findings.quote: The Yeatman Gastronomic Restaurant at The Yeatman holds two Michelin Stars which were awarded in November 2016.

claims.text: Partner wineries sponsor individual rooms and suites, with pictures and objects about each winery adding an individual accent to each guest room.

findings.quote: These partner wineries also sponsor individual rooms and suites. Intriguing pictures and objects provide insights into each winery's unique history and environment and add a discreet individual accent to each guest room.

claims.text: The hotel has outdoor and indoor infinity swimming pools.

findings.quote: has outdoor and indoor infinity swimming pools and Wine Spa

claims.text: The wine theme extends to The Yeatman Wine Spa, with its exclusive skincare products and therapies.

findings.quote: The wine theme extends to The Yeatman Wine Spa with its exclusive skincare products and therapies.

claims.text: The Presidential Suite Panoramic has a private pool, a barrel bed, a spacious terrace and a private garden, with views over Porto and the Douro.

findings.quote: The Hotel’s most luxurious suite with a private pool, barrel bed, spacious terrace and private garden, enjoying magnificent views over Porto and the Douro river.

claims.text: The hotel's address is in Vila Nova de Gaia, on the south bank of the Douro, looking over Porto's historic centre rather than in it.

findings.quote: Vila Nova de Gaia
Occupying a commanding hillside position on the south bank of the River Douro, every room at The Yeatman Hotel enjoys breathtaking views over the historic centre of Porto.

claims.text: The hotel does not recommend The Yeatman Gastronomic Restaurant for children under 12; its menu is a tasting menu with no children's menu, while The Orangerie has a children's menu.

findings.quote: Please note that we do not recommend The Yeatman Gastronomic Restaurant for children under the age of 12 years old.
The menu in The Yeatman Gastronomic Restaurant is a  tasting menu and there is no children’s menu available.
our more informal restaurant The Orangerie, which has a bespoke children's menu available

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the hillside location means getting transportation to the city centre.
